app.name: Crypto Regime Manager
app.mode: TEL/TAO advisory + SUI research + immutable candidate registry

portfolio.operating_rule: Production rankings include TEL and TAO only. Research assets never become live recommendations automatically.

safeguards: Cross-asset tests are diagnostic evidence, not permission to change production strategies
Every asset keeps its own frozen baseline settings
The transferred rule is applied to the same named regime only
A rule must improve more than one asset before it can be described as generalisable
No production strategy is changed automatically
evidence_library.note: The evidence library compares suggested rules across TEL, TAO, and SUI. Results use each asset’s available KuCoin history and are not independent forward validation.

safeguards: Asset DNA records how each tested rule affects each asset; it does not alter production settings
Scores combine profit, drawdown, duration, and deal-count effects relative to the frozen baseline
A small evidence set is labelled low confidence
Similar assets are suggestions for future research, not proof that settings transfer
Every live amendment still requires an asset-specific forward test and manual approval
asset_dna.note: Asset DNA is a compact research profile built from the evidence library. It grows as more distinct hypotheses and assets are tested.
